decision_meaning: Only the exact one-time 2025-02 fresh falsification may proceed after all seven P0 requirements are mechanically verified. This record alone is not download permission.

automatic_invalidation: frozen plan or any bound artifact digest changes
identity calibration changes or any calibration fit is introduced
candidate, control, cohort, action, threshold, cost, state boundary, gate, date, or claim boundary changes
any February target is read or downloaded before the release rule is satisfied

calibration.reason: A post-hoc calibration fit after viewing negative January development results would be model rescue.

p0_requirements.name: VERSIONED_GOVERNANCE_DISAMBIGUATION
p0_requirements.acceptance: Retain the Jan-only rule as historical v1 and add S0-009-FEB-FALSIFICATION-v1, superseding only the statement that every February use is a scope breach.

p0_requirements.name: REAL_BOOKDEPTH_SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY
p0_requirements.acceptance: Require exactly one -1 and one +1 level per timestamp, allow other levels, do not require 0, and reject duplicate +/-1 levels.

p0_requirements.name: UNPATCHED_84_ZIP_INTEGRATION
p0_requirements.acceptance: A real-schema fixture must complete 84 ZIP plus 84 CHECKSUM through acquisition, verification, authorized execution, and SCORING_COMPLETE without patching fresh rows; it must prove no model or calibration fit.

p0_requirements.name: POST_CONSUMPTION_FAILURE_SEALING
p0_requirements.acceptance: Every model-load, parser, digest, or scoring failure after consumption must write SCORING_FAILED_CONSUMED and terminally synchronize the registry, including a consume-then-model-delete test.

p0_requirements.name: ALL_FROZEN_COVERAGE_GATES
p0_requirements.acceptance: Execute and test UTC-day, state, and direction concentration limits; map zero effective episodes to STOP_DATA_INVALID under frozen precedence.

p0_requirements.name: EXACT_AUTHORIZATION_AND_ARTIFACT_ALLOWLIST
p0_requirements.acceptance: Verify this exact decision ID plus the bound v4 paths, file digests, and development-source digest; reject wrong decision IDs and old v3 artifacts.

p0_requirements.name: PRE_DOWNLOAD_FACT_ARTIFACTS
p0_requirements.acceptance: Cross-bind this decision, the amendment, a newly generated ALL_TARGETS_ABSENT inventory, authorization receipt, execution contract, P0 test-report SHA, and post-fix runner, evaluator, and package SHAs.

one_time_result_mapping.condition: inputs incomplete and scoring not started
zero effective episodes or structural invalidity

one_time_mapping_rule: No terminal WAIT, STOP, FAILED, or COMPLETE result may be followed by tuning and another evaluation on the same February window. WAIT_DATA_NOT_SCORED does not claim that scoring ran, but its receipt is terminal and any read input is permanently SEEN.
maximum_positive_claim: The fixed January model was not rejected by the preregistered diagnostic gates on one frozen February proxy cohort.
forbidden_claims: any H hypothesis is supported or disproved
market validity or profitability is established
G1, G2, paper, deployment, or trading readiness is achieved
the system may trade or use real funds
notice: CONDITIONAL_AUTHORIZE is a governance decision, not proof that any P0 is closed, any February input was downloaded, or any test report, receipt, contract, or package digest exists.
